dct_description_sm:
To increase transparency and to facilitate access to information on substances in Canadian commerce, the Government of Canada is publishing a compilation of the non-confidential information received in response to the Notice with respect to certain substances under the Chemicals Management Plan — 2023. The notice was published on June 24, 2023, in the Canada Gazette, Part I, pursuant to section 71 of the Canadian Environmental Protection Act, 1999 (CEPA). The notice collected information on the commercial status, industrial processes (for example, facility releases) and downstream use of 850 substances, from manufacturers, importers, those who used these substances to produce goods and in other activities for the 2022 calendar year. The data collected will be used to inform further prioritization decisions, risk assessment activities and risk management, if needed. 

A compilation of the non-confidential information is available for download in Excel and CSV formats. It should be noted that these documents do not include an assessment of the potential risks these substances may pose to the environment or to the health of people in Canada. 

When reviewing the data, it is important to consider:  

- the definitions applicable to the notice; 

- the persons required to provide information;  

- the exclusions; and 

- the reporting requirements. 

 

Please refer to the notice or guidance document for further details on data collected.
dct_title_s: Information received in response to the Notice with respect to certain substances under the Chemicals Management Plan — 2023
